state.background: Phase 6 batch B13 transfers exactly three Plan45 Pixel 7 Chromium touch scenarios to Browser Mode: p45-b-tooltip-dismiss-473-case01 (#473), p45-b-tooltip-dismiss-508-case01 (#508), and p45-b-tooltip-dismiss-535-case01 (#535). All use the shared __MOUNT_ALL__ fixture and production route in Pixel 7 touch context (effective viewport 412x839, screen 412x915). #473 touches the stacked-chart wrapper center, verifies close visible, cursor count=1 and active-dot count>0, then touches the chart heading outside the wrapper and verifies close hidden, cursor count=0 and active-dot count=0. #508 touches the stacked-chart wrapper center, verifies close visible and active dots>0, then touches close and verifies close hidden and active-dot count=0; it does not assert post-close cursor count. #535 touches the salary tab, immediately reads the CPI wrapper bounding box, and dispatches CDP touchStart/touchEnd only if a box exists. It does not check viewport bounds or hit-test that point; the point may be offscreen. Its assertions are only close hidden before and after scroll settles with at least two stable samples within five seconds. It must not be described as proving suppression of an on-screen touch. Independent implementation and post-cutover source audits passed. Focused Browser Mode passed 3/3; residual E2E completed build/type-check and passed 3 with 7 skipped. Starting from B12 M=120, B13 advances M to 123; all 33 Phase 6 eligible IDs now have accepted batch cutovers. Separate unknown-provenance changes remain: two removed post-wheel assertions from P42 #231 and an unattributed desktop hover-dismiss test deletion. They are outside B13 and excluded from its accounting.
acceptanceCriteria: All three B13 stable IDs preserve their mapped source assertions in permanent fail-on-contract Browser Mode tests under Pixel 7 touch context and the shared fixture.
#473 preserves wrapper-center touch, close visible, cursor count=1, active dots>0, then heading-outside-wrapper touch and close hidden/cursor=0/active dots=0.
#508 preserves wrapper-center touch, close visible and active dots>0, then close touch and close hidden/active dots=0; no post-close cursor-count assertion is claimed.

#535 preserves salary-tab touch, immediate CPI wrapper bbox read, and conditional CDP touchStart/touchEnd only if the box exists, without viewport-bounds or hit-test checks. Its assertions are close hidden before and after scroll settles with at least two stable samples within five seconds; it is not presented as proving on-screen touch suppression.

Only the three B13 source blocks were cut over; the P42 #231 post-wheel assertion removals and unattributed desktop hover-dismiss deletion remain separate unknown-provenance changes and are not counted in B13.

Focused Browser Mode and residual E2E gates pass, and independent implementation/source audits support the cutover; cumulative ledger advances from M=120 to M=123, covering all 33 eligible Phase 6 IDs.
verification: Focused run `pnpm run test:browser:phase6-b13:built` passed one file / three tests. Durable log: results/plan45/phase6/phase6-b13-browser-mode-validation-2026-09-27.log.

After source cutover, residual `pnpm test:e2e:fresh` completed build/type-check and passed 3 tests with 7 skipped and zero failures. Durable log: results/plan45/phase6/phase6-b13-residual-e2e-validation-2026-09-27.log.
Independent implementation and post-cutover source-boundary audits passed.
knownConstraints: This checkpoint covers B13 only; the cumulative Phase 6 eligible set is 33/33 accepted following this batch.

#535's conditional wrapper-center touch may use a point outside the screen, and neither the test nor source contract verifies on-screen bounds or hit-testing. Do not infer genuine on-screen touch suppression from the close-hidden checks.
Two removed post-wheel assertions from P42 #231 and an unattributed desktop hover-dismiss test deletion retain unknown provenance; they remain outside B13 and are not counted as transferred.
state.outputRequirement: Choose exactly one criterion for this implementation checkpoint. Provide effective verdict, decision summary and full choice distribution, evidence tied to B13 IDs and artifact paths, any required correction with exact location, and remaining uncertainty. Do not overstate #535 as evidence about an on-screen or hit-tested touch. Do not claim a post-close cursor assertion for #508. Keep P42 #231 and desktop unknown-provenance changes separate from B13. If the initial choice is not valid_as_defined, follow exactly one required case-specific clarification and preserve the initial result; do not turn a non-pass into a pass.

implementation.instructions: Evaluate whether B13 is a valid full cutover under the acceptance criteria and evidence. Select the single best matching criterion.

criteria.valid_as_defined: The supplied source-contract, cutover, ledger, and verification evidence supports accepting B13 as defined with the #535 limitation disclosed.
criteria.requirements_mismatch: A concrete conflict exists between requirements and implementation or recorded evidence; identify the requirement and requirement-only correction.
criteria.missing_prerequisites_info: Required prerequisite information is missing; identify exactly what is needed.
criteria.incomplete_implementation_info: Specific evidence needed to assess B13 is missing; identify the exact gap.
criteria.implementation_issue: A concrete implementation or reporting defect violates a criterion; name the location, evidence, and implementation-only correction.
criteria.scope_violation: The cutover exceeds or falls outside the agreed batch boundary; identify the boundary and adjustment.
criteria.other: A different concrete validity issue exists; state the finding, location, evidence, and next action.
criteria.indeterminate: The supplied context cannot support a decision; identify the missing context and resolving evidence.
